newsitem.title: FRANCE: France slightly raises sugar beet crop estimate.
newsitem.headline: France slightly raises sugar beet crop estimate.

text.p: France slightly raised its estimate for the 1996 sugar beet crop to 29.63 million tonnes from 29.33 million tonnes forecast last month.
This would still represent a 3.1 percent fall from the 30.57 million tonnes produced in 1995.
The ministry's statistical office, SCEES, said it had raised its estimate for the national beet yield to 65.1 tonnes per hectare from 64.3 tonnes targeted last month.
This would still be below the 66.9 tonnes reached in 1995.
The ministry kept its sowings estimate for 1996 unchanged from last month at 456,000 hectares, down 1,000 ha from 1995.
Sugar content was put at 17.4 percent up from 17.2 percent forecast last month but down from 17.5 percent last year.
